svg.title: Uno R3 and BMP180 I2C Wiring

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: J1 is a logical connector. Pin order shown: VCC, SDA, SCL, GND. Connect Uno A4/SDA to SDA and A5/SCL to SCL. The common BMP180 address is 0x77.

g.desc: J1 is a logical connector. Pin order shown: VCC, SDA, SCL, GND. Connect Uno A4/SDA to SDA and A5/SCL to SCL. The common BMP180 address is 0x77.

g.text: This drawing assumes a breakout powered from Uno 3.3 V with SDA/SCL pulled up to 3.3 V. Check the exact board before powering it; some breakouts require a different supply. Use level translation when needed. KiCad checks cover this logical wiring only; hardware is untested.
